lines.fallback: They wait for you to speak.

choices.label: Could you help clear the boulders from the path?
What work do you do here?

lines.text: Yes. I'll take care of it.
I work my post for the settlement.
Alright. I'll be here if you need me.

Give me a moment. I'll get these shifted.
